title: 第一卷 第17章 再次购买灵药第一卷 第18章 突破
slug: 我为族长当缔造诸天万界之禁忌家族
content_zh:
这时。
顾天阳又想到了丹药的事。
先前炼制的四千五百颗精元丹和四千五百颗聚气丹，看似数量庞大。
但顾家上下足足有三千余人。
其中炼体境占了九成九，聚气境少得可怜。
这么一算，问题便凸显出来了。
炼体境子弟每人分摊下来，精元丹不过几枚而已。
对于提升实力和突破瓶颈的族人而言，这点丹药无异于杯水车薪。
顶多只能支撑三五天的修炼所需。
“不够，实在是太少了。”
顾天阳眉头微蹙，心中暗道。
如今顾家正值多事之秋，想要让家族快速提升实力，甚至逆势崛起。
丹药，便是提升实力最直接的途径。
“看来，得再去一趟万宝阁，采购一批灵药才行。”
顾天阳眼中闪过一抹精光。
既然要全力发展家族，那就不能有丝毫吝啬。
先前新手大礼包奖励的灵晶，此刻正好派上用场。
说去就去，顾天阳向来不是拖泥带水之人。
他心念一动，腰间的天隐玉瞬间激活？
原本俊朗的面容再次变成了那张扔在人堆里毫不起眼的青年模样。

修为气息也被压制在聚气境九层，比上次高了不少。
做好伪装后，顾天阳避开了家族弟子的视线。
依旧从顾家后门悄然离开，朝着万宝阁快步走去。
此时的青云城街道上，人流如织，修士往来不绝。
不少人都在议论着顾家与王家的事情。
王嫣然觉醒天木灵体，又成为了青木宗真传弟子。
将要去顾家退婚的消息，早已传遍了整座青云城。
有不少人都抱着看戏的心态，等着看顾家如何应对。
顾天阳混在人群中，听着周围的议论声，脸上没有丝毫波澜。
这些流言蜚语对他而言，不过是过眼云烟，唯有绝对的实力，才能打破一切质疑。
不多时，万宝阁那座气势磅礴的阁楼便出现在了眼前。
门口的侍女见顾天阳走来，立刻满脸笑容地迎了上来。
“这位公子，里边请。”
顾天阳微微颔首，没有多言，走进了万宝阁。
他熟门熟路地朝着灵药区域走去，上次接待他的那位侍女见状，连忙快步跟了上来，脸上带着笑容。
“公子，您又来采购灵药？”
“嗯。”
顾天阳淡淡应了一声，目光已经落在了货架上的各种灵药上。
content_en:
At this time.
Gu Tianyang thought about the elixir again.
The 4,500 Jingyuan Pills and 4,500 Qi Gathering Pills that were previously refined seemed to be a huge amount.
But there are more than 3,000 people in the Gu family.
Among them, the body refining realm accounts for 99%, and the Qi gathering realm is pitifully small.
After doing this calculation, the problem becomes apparent.
The disciples of the Body Refining Realm only had a few Jingyuan Pills if they shared it among themselves.
For the tribesmen who want to improve their strength and break through bottlenecks, this pill is nothing more than a drop in the bucket.
At most it can only support three to five days of practice.
"It's not enough, it's really too little."
Gu Tianyang frowned slightly and thought to himself.
Nowadays, the Gu family is in a troubled time, and they want the family to quickly increase its strength, or even rise against the trend.
Pills are the most direct way to improve your strength.
"It seems that we have to go to Wanbao Pavilion again to purchase a batch of elixirs."
A glint flashed in Gu Tianyang's eyes.
Since we want to develop our family with all our strength, we cannot be stingy in the slightest.
The spiritual crystals that were previously rewarded in the novice gift package came in handy now.
Just go as you say, Gu Tianyang has never been a sloppy person.
With a thought in his mind, the Tianyin Jade on his waist was instantly activated?
The originally handsome face once again changed into the appearance of an inconspicuous young man thrown into the crowd.
The cultivation aura was also suppressed at the ninth level of the Qi Gathering Realm, which was much higher than last time.
After putting on a good disguise, Gu Tianyang avoided the eyes of the family disciples.
He still quietly left through the back door of Gu's house and walked quickly towards Wanbao Pavilion.
At this time, the streets of Qingyun City were filled with people and monks were constantly coming and going.
Many people are talking about the affairs of the Gu family and the Wang family.
Wang Yanran awakened the Tianmu spirit body and became a true disciple of the Qingmu Sect.
The news that he was going to the Gu family to break off the engagement had already spread throughout Qingyun City.
Many people had the mentality of watching a show, waiting to see how the Gu family would respond.
Gu Tianyang mingled among the crowd, listening to the discussions around him, with no trace of emotion on his face.
To him, these rumors and rumors are nothing but passing smoke. Only absolute strength can break all doubts.
Not long after, the majestic attic of Wanbao Pavilion appeared in front of him.
When the maid at the door saw Gu Tianyang approaching, she immediately came over with a smile on her face.
"This young master, please come in."
Gu Tianyang nodded slightly and walked into Wanbao Pavilion without saying anything.
He walked towards the elixir area in a familiar manner. Seeing this, the maid who received him last time quickly followed him with a smile on her face.
"Sir, are you here to buy elixir again?"
"Yeah."
Gu Tianyang responded lightly, his eyes already falling on the various elixirs on the shelves.
